evidence.scope: Main line-emitting remnant; faint northern OIII ejecta jet poorly traced
evidence.limitations: Released 416573-row table contains flux-selected components, no per-row errors or spectral-frame metadata; not gas density.
Velocity is not observed depth. We retain the authors linear-expansion interpretation; global acceleration and nonhomology remain.

evidence.quantity: proper-motion sample and mean convergence date
evidence.scope: Most bright filaments; weakest acceleration toward east/west bays
evidence.limitations: Convergence date differs from explosion1054. Do not rescale all multi-epoch images to force filaments together.

evidence.scope: Includes faint northern OIII ejecta jet, distinct from central relativistic X-ray jets
evidence.limitations: New arrays not acquired; do not invent the jet outside selected RGB footprints or extrapolate older red-line table to it.

evidence.scope: Inner pulsar wind, Chandra fit; outer and inner fitted separately
evidence.limitations: Sigmas fixed by authors. Statistical errors do not include all model errors. Selected baseline; no calibrated synchrotron transfer or evolution model.
Alternative to selected torus pair, not averaged into it. Peak and inner-edge radii differ. Nonunique deprojection; observed ellipse offset does not determine a unique flow.

evidence.scope: Main JWST mosaic; spectra at two small filament pointings only
evidence.limitations: Warm dust favors dense filament cores and multiple synchrotron bays. Outreach magenta is not dust density, opacity, or independent mass. NIRCam astrometry tied toGaiaDR2; component views reuse same photons.

evidence.scope: 2012 VLA main remnant map with expanded older large-scale template
evidence.limitations: PublisherRGB is display signal. Fine radio filaments and knots are nonstellar; preserve them. Beam is not .10015arcsec RGB sampling.

evidence.scope: GaiaDR3 3403818172572314624; SIMBAD propagated J2000 ICRS position
evidence.limitations: Catalogue angular position only. No relative line-of-sight position inside ejecta; model z=0 and rendered point size are authored.

evidence.scope: Four EVN epochs2015-2017; differential calibrator astrometry
evidence.limitations: Selected ejecta conversion retains original2kpc conditional model for reproducibility; modern measurement is compatible. Do not confuse paper pointing centres with measured pulsar positions.

evidence.scope: Full released point table compared with its own deep-frame emission, then deep-frame stars to Hubble
evidence.limitations: Original table omits units/origin. Same-observation line/deep matching is internal dataset coordinate qualification, not independent astrometry. Conservatively~.4arcsec combined local uncertainty; fixed raw-grid scale, no morphology correction across epochs.

evidence.scope: Local rotating visualization; positive emissivity only
evidence.limitations: Smoothing, relative component weights, finite jet lengths, pulsar radius/alpha, and field-star depths are display assumptions. At approximately1.4arcsec grid spacing, sigma0.5cell has about1.65arcsec FWHM, coarser than SITELLE seeing1.17±0.04arcsec. The initial128cell/sigma1 prototype was replaced before completed visual qualification. Absorption/scattering, relativistic beaming, and time evolution are not solved.

evidence.quantity: extended synchrotron morphology distinct from line-emitting ejecta and inner tori

value.orientation: SE-NW, approximately the pulsar jet axis

evidence.scope: Main PWN; larger than the selected close optical/infrared footprints and current sampled field. X-rays are more compact than optical/IR and radio.
evidence.limitations: Published projected morphology does not give continuum depth. The current RGB residual also includes dust, lines, NOX leakage and epoch mismatch; do not label all fitted residual synchrotron.

evidence.quantity: bounded inferred diffuse-emission prior and image fit
evidence.scope: Current registered image coverage and existing sampled volume bounds only. Chandra retains the independent inner-wind baseline.
evidence.limitations: Finite spherical 3D kernels occupy a fixed tilted ellipsoidal lattice; only full kernels contained in the inspected field are eligible. Nonnegative coefficients and one filament gain are fitted independently per lens. No point displacement, velocity change, photo extrusion or recovered continuum depth. Withheld image pixels test interpolation, not physical truth. The complete 7.6 arcmin PWN outskirts are outside this bounded reconstruction.

implementationContract: Separate ejecta, synchrotron wind, and central pulsar; radio/X-ray compact features are not field stars.
Retain six observation lenses; shared physical components are weighted per tracer, with independent neutral union.
No reconstructed extension where data are missing; no astrophysical density or optical-depth claim.
